title: Right-to-Know Request – October 2026 Trump–Epstein Memorial Bookmobile Event

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Pennsylvania Right to Know Act, I hereby request the following records:

Records concerning the October 1–2, 2026, Trump–Epstein Memorial Bookmobile event in Harrisburg involving congressional candidate Janelle Stelson and Epstein survivor Sharlene Rochard.

For the period August 1 through November 26, 2026, please provide:

- Official correspondence concerning the planning, authorization, organization and promotion of the event.

- Event-related communications with Janelle Stelson's congressional campaign, the Institute for Primary Facts, DEFIANCE.org, Bookmobile organizers and City of Harrisburg officials.

- Applications, permits, reservations, parking authorizations and administrative approvals concerning the use of state property in connection with the event.

- Financial records, including contracts, invoices, expenditures, fees, fee waivers and reimbursements.

- Records documenting the use of state personnel, equipment, facilities or other public resources.

- Invitations, briefing materials, official calendar entries and records documenting state officials' participation, if any.

Please search responsive records maintained by the Capitol Complex special events office, facilities management and relevant administrative offices.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Michael Tracey
